channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Pequenos partidos, grandes negócios
item.description: Two ideologically opposed Brazilian parties - the PCO (far-left) and PRTB (far-right) - are under Federal Police investigation for suspected misuse of electoral campaign funds. Their shared pursuit of financial interests across the political spectrum indicates that ideological divisions may yield to common profit motives.

item.title: Governo Lula estuda cobrar contribuição de empresas para conter pejotização, diz Durigan
item.description: The federal government is considering creating a social security contribution for companies with a high proportion of contractors (PJ) to combat abusive outsourcing. Finance Minister Dario Durigan indicated the measure could be prioritized in a potential fourth term of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's administration.

item.title: Cristian Cravinhos declara voto em Flávio: “Chega de impunidade”
item.description: Cristian Cravinhos, convicted in the von Richthofen case, endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), emphasizing the fight against impunity and issues in healthcare and education.

item.title: Durigan diz que desvincular Previdência é ideia de Guedes e que ‘aqui é outro papo’
item.description: Minister of Finance Dario Durigan announced the 2026 minimum wage of BRL 1,741, linked to social security and welfare benefits, contrasting with Paulo Guedes' proposal to unlink the minimum wage from social security. Durigan emphasized the Lula government's commitment to the needy population and stated that this administration differs from the previous one.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio dá entrevista a jornalistas em Maceió
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) gave a press conference in Maceió as part of his campaign schedule. His agenda also included a motorcade, a meeting with business leaders, and participation in the Convention of the Ministers of the Assemblies of God.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai à comemoração do Dia do Soldado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), running for re-election, attends a ceremony commemorating Soldier's Day at the Army Headquarters in Brasília.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (25)
item.description: On Tuesday (25), presidential candidates continue with an intense campaign schedule, featuring debates, interviews, events, and grassroots activities. Highlights include rallies, leafleting, meetings with business leaders and religious figures, and visits to public institutions. Each candidate showcases distinct communication and mobilization strategies.

item.title: O respiro que Lula deve ter por bom momento na relação com Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula's allies hope his improved relationship with Alcolumbre delays a CPI into the president's son until after elections. The opposition seeks to pressure the Congress speaker to move the commission forward in September, but Planalto sources consider it unlikely while both leaders remain conciliatory.

item.title: Roberta, Lulinha e famílias viajaram para África e para a Finlândia
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger funded trips for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, and relatives to Africa and Finland. Expenses, investigated by federal police, included safari in southern Africa and Scandinavian tour in 2025.

item.title: Renan Santos promete rever renúncias fiscais e cita Zona Franca
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) stated in a TMC town hall that he intends to review hundreds of billions of reais in tax waivers if he assumes the presidency, while keeping exemptions for the Simples Nacional and MEI. He also highlighted the Zona Franca as a focus of analysis in this tax agenda. The proposal aims to balance revenue collection with the protection of strategic sectors and small taxpayers.

item.title: Lobista amiga de Lulinha movimentava altas quantias em espécie, diz PF
item.description: Federal Police is investigating Lulinha, the son of President Lula, over alleged cash transactions linked to a lobbyist. The inquiry claims the lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger paid for a trip and had ties to figures under investigation for social security fraud.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que presidente não pode agir como CEO de empresa
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential candidate from Missão, stated that comparing a head of state to a CEO is pathetic, criticizing the application of private-sector management logic to public administration. In an interview with TMC, he argued that a country cannot be treated like a company, as it cannot be shut down like a business.

item.title: Bolsonaristas vão ficar sem senador no Rio?
item.description: A poll by Instituto Paraná Pesquisas suggests that Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro's PL may fail to elect any senator in Rio de Janeiro. Benedita da Silva (PT) and Marcelo Crivella (Republicanos) lead the Senate race in the state.

item.title: Quaest: veja os números da eleição para presidente nos estados
item.description: Quaest released a new round of polls on the 2026 presidential race across six states (Alagoas, Maranhão, Paraná, Rio Grande do Norte, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina), with interviews conducted between August 20-23 and a margin of error of 3 percentage points. The surveys test two first-round scenarios, with and without Pablo Marçal (PRTB), who is ineligible but filed his candidacy registration. Lula leads in all surveyed states, with a 15-point advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro in Alagoas and more than 30 points in Maranhão, his best performance among the six states.

item.title: Fim da escala 6×1: relator promete parecer até quinta-feira, 27
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz (PSD-AM) vows to deliver his report on the bill ending the 6×1 work schedule by Thursday, 27, keeping a favorable stance. The measure, approved by the Chamber, reduces weekly working hours from 44 to 40 with two paid days off, implemented gradually. Its passage hinges on Senate committee approval and floor votes.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba quais são as atribuições de senadores e deputados
item.description: In the 2026 elections, Brazilians will vote for legislative representatives at both federal and state levels, including senators, federal deputies, and state/district deputies. Senators, serving eight-year terms, represent their states, draft laws, and oversee the executive branch, also participating in impeachment trials and presidential appointments. Federal deputies, with four-year terms, represent the population and engage in national legislation.

item.title: Tarifaço: Lula edita MP que prorroga suspensão de tributos para exportadores
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva issued Provisional Measure 1.386, extending for up to one year the suspension of taxes under the special drawback customs regime for exporters. The measure aims to mitigate the impacts of the tariff hikes on Brazil's export sector, maintaining tax incentives and the competitiveness of national products in the international market.

item.title: Hugo Motta critica adversário do pai: “Vazio, amargo e só vomita ódio”
item.description: The president of Brazil's Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), harshly attacked Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB), calling him "empty, bitter" and accusing him of "only vomiting hate" while delivering nothing to Paraíba. Motta also accused Veneziano of using his brother Vital do Rêgo's influence as head of the TCU to blackmail mayors. The clash has an electoral context: Motta's father, Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos), is Veneziano's main opponent in the Senate race in Paraíba, and Motta is seeking Lula's support to boost his father's campaign.

item.title: Brasil e EUA remarcam reunião sobre tarifaço para a próxima semana
item.description: The meeting between Minister Márcio Elias Rosa and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer has been rescheduled for early next week, possibly on August 31, to resume negotiations over the tariffs imposed by the United States. The US has applied surcharges of up to 37.5% on certain Brazilian products since July 2026, following an investigation into forced labor. The Lula government has filed WTO consultations and initiated the Economic Reciprocity Law process, though any retaliatory measure is not expected before December.

item.title: ‘Vocês vão parar no tempo? Não sou eu que tenho que prestar conta, é o Lula’, diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre contas do filme ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he does not need to account for the 'Dark Horse' film, but former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva should provide explanations regarding a meeting with Daniel Vorcaro and Augusto Lima. He questioned the press focus on a private production amid Brazil's economic crisis. The senator emphasized that the Go Up Entertainment producer has already submitted documentation to the investigation in São Paulo.

item.title: Renan Santos promete falar “o que pensa” até a eleição
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Mission) stated that he intends to maintain the confrontational tone adopted in the first presidential debate and continue to challenge his main opponents throughout the campaign. In an interview with TMC, the MBL founder declared he will not moderate his stance until the October election.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula defende mais imposto para super-ricos
item.description: José Sergio Gabrielli, coordinator of Lula's reelection government program, advocated raising taxes on the super-rich and the National Treasury repurchasing public bonds to reduce volatility in the interest rate curve. He attributed Brazil's rising public debt to interest charges rather than uncontrolled spending. The PT's program, filed with the TSE, aims to 'put the poor in the budget and the rich in the income tax'.

item.title: Renan Santos, Ronaldo Caiado e Augusto Cury: o que uniu candidatos no primeiro debate presidencial
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Rede Bandeirantes, featured only three candidates holding around 10% of voter intentions combined: Augusto Cury (Avante), Renan Santos (Missão), and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD). It was the most sparsely attended debate since 1989, with the participants using the opportunity to attack the absent frontrunners Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Over the course of an hour and a half, the candidates discussed proposals and strategies against the polling leaders.

item.title: Equipe de Lula vê economia como tema-chave e quer aliados munidos para defender reeleição
item.description: Lula's team believes the economy will be a decisive issue in the 2026 elections and wants allies prepared to defend the government's achievements to argue in favor of his reelection. Despite concerns over the Lulinha and Marcola case, the reading is that this episode only rules out a first-round victory, keeping the race open. For the runoff, they assess that Lula has better chances than Flávio Bolsonaro, his main opponent, who is expected to partially recover from the Dark Horse case revelations.

item.title: Crusoé: Ruas não decola nem sem Garotinho, aponta Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas poll released on August 25 shows that Douglas Ruas (PL), president of the Rio de Janeiro State Assembly and the candidate backed by Flávio Bolsonaro for governor, is not gaining traction in the race even with the possible absence of Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) from the ballot. The result highlights the difficulty faced by the PL's chosen name in establishing competitiveness in the state of Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Lula vai ao QG do Exército, em Brasília, para celebrar o Dia do Soldado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) attended the Soldier's Day ceremony at the Army General Staff in Brasília, reinforcing institutional ties with the Armed Forces. The event took place at 10 a.m. on Tuesday, highlighting the Army's relevance in national life.

item.title: Janja repudia fala de Renan Santos em debate presidencial da 'Band' e do 'Estadão'
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva condemned Renan Santos' statements during the presidential debate hosted by Band and Estadão, labeling them as misogynistic and used to attack President Lula. She emphasized that the candidate misused her image without permission to derail from the debate's intended topic.

item.title: Real Time: Eduardo Leite é aprovado por 56% dos eleitores no RS
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) is approved by 56% of voters in Rio Grande do Sul, according to a Real Time poll released on August 25th. Disapproval stands at 38%, while 6% did not express an opinion.

item.title: Agenda dos Presidenciáveis 2026 reúne propostas do Sistema Comércio para desenvolvimento do Brasil
item.description: The CNC-Sesc-Senac System launched in Brasília the 2026 Presidential Candidates Agenda, a 70-page document outlining proposals from the tertiary sector to inform the electoral debate and Brazil's development. The recommendations are organized around seven pillars: economic development, entrepreneurship, technology and digital transformation, foreign trade, security and the fight against illegality, labor and qualification, as well as regional development and sustainability. The initiative reinforces the CNC's institutional role as a technical interlocutor with the presidential pre-candidates.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula cumpre agenda militar em Brasília; Flávio leva a campanha para Alagoas
item.description: Lula attends institutional agenda for Soldier's Day in Brasília, not directly linked to his re-election campaign. Flávio Bolsonaro takes his campaign to Alagoas with a convoy, meetings, and a religious event. Other candidates such as Caiado, Renan Santos, and Zema also campaign across various fronts in the country.

item.title: Família de Rubens Paiva se mobiliza por candidatura de neto à Câmara
item.description: The family of Rubens Paiva, inspired by the story told in the film 'Ainda Estou Aqui', financially supports the candidacy of Chico Rubens Paiva (PSB-RJ) for the Chamber of Deputies. The grandson of the former federal deputy and Eunice Paiva seeks election with a left-wing platform, opposes Bolsonarism, and has already received donations from relatives and public figures like Armínio Fraga.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta a fugir de perguntas sobre Vorcaro e tenta culpar imprensa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro dodged questions about the financial disclosure of 'Dark Horse' funding from banker Daniel Vorcaro and redirected criticism toward Lula and his son Lulinha. Despite promising transparency in May, he failed to release documents by the deadline. The case involves $10.6 million funneled through the Texan fund Havengate.

item.title: STF aprova gratificação para funcionários públicos comissionados
item.description: On Friday (August 21, 2026), the STF approved the creation of Gaacta, a gratification of up to 22.5% for 276 public officials in high-complexity positions such as advisors and ministry chiefs of staff, with no retroactive payment and subject to the constitutional wage cap.

item.title: Após Janja reagir a ofensas, Renan Santos a chama de "rainha louca"
item.description: Following the Band presidential debate, during which he made offensive remarks toward First Lady Janja Lula da Silva, Renan Santos (Missão) labeled her 'crazy and dazzled queen' in response to her rebuke. He also accused her of interfering in the Lula administration and spreading fake news, maintaining an aggressive tone.

item.title: Mensagens sugerem que sócio de Lulinha criou perfil fake para atacar Janja
item.description: Messages obtained by the Federal Police suggest that Roberta Luchsinger told Lulinha that Kalil Bittar created a fake profile to attack Janja, while a company involved allegedly negotiated with Telebras. The lobbyist and other suspects accused of an alleged secret society are under investigation for influence trafficking in Lula's government.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram que perspectiva de crise vai influenciar o voto
item.description: Polls indicate that economic crisis and stagnation are influencing the election, with Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading voter intentions at 40% and 35%, respectively. Half of voters remain undecided, and rejection rates for candidates stay high.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas lidera disputa pelo governo de SP, diz Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 55% of voting intentions against 36% for Fernando Haddad in a potential second round. The survey, registered with the TSE under number SP-01477/2026, interviewed 1,800 voters from August 19-24 with a margin of error of 2.3 percentage points.

item.title: Flávio tem 48% contra 41% de Lula no 2º turno em SP, diz Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll released on August 25, 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 48% against Lula's 41% in a simulated São Paulo 2nd-round race. The survey, with a 2.3-point margin of error, was registered with the TSE and cost R$ 12,000.

item.title: Livro com histórias de novelas brasileiras explica relação entre 'Sassá Mutema' e Lula
item.description: The character Sassá Mutema, from the telenovela 'O Salvador da Pátria', is widely believed to be inspired by Lula, who ran in the first direct presidential election after the dictatorship in 1989. Years later, Lula asked the author of the telenovela, Lauro César Muniz, whether the character was based on him, and the writer simply smiled. These stories are featured in the book 'Autoria e gênero na telenovela brasileira', by Tatiana Siciliano and Francisco Malta, released on October 31.

item.title: Lulinha vira alvo diário no STF enquanto apuração de Flávio empaca
item.description: The investigation involving Lula's son moves quickly at the STF, while the Banco Master case linked to Flávio Bolsonaro remains stalled. The difference in pace fuels suspicions of unequal treatment.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro empurra Dark Horse para pertinho das urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is caught in a scheme of credit assignments to candidate Dark Horse, later denying and confirming a leaked audio, promising financial transparency that never materializes, exposing his campaign's mismanagement.

item.title: ANPD multa TikTok em R$ 153,7 milhões por falhas no tratamento de dados de crianças e adolescentes
item.description: The Brazilian data protection authority fined TikTok's local operator $28 million for mishandling children's data, violating the LGPD. The company lacked legal grounds to process such data and failed preventive safeguards. The ruling also mandates deletion of improperly registered teen data within 60 days.

item.title: Fala de Zema sobre mulheres “não foi ato falho”, diz petista mineira
item.description: Ana Elisa (PT) claimed Romeu Zema's remarks on 'programs against women' reflect his stance, not a slip-up. She criticized the state government for not joining the National Pact against Femicide and failing to prioritize women's safety.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro empata com Lula no 1º turno e vence no 2º no Rio Grande do Sul, indica pesquisa
item.description: A survey in Rio Grande do Sul shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the first round and a 10-point lead for Flávio in the second round. Conducted by Real Time Big Data, the poll considers only local voters and indicates Flávio leading when votes are restricted to the state.

item.title: Os modestos planos do PL em Alagoas, estado do vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL aims to elect only one federal deputy in Alagoas, despite it being the state of Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate. The modest goal contrasts with ambitious plans in other states, such as Ceará (6 deputies) and Minas Gerais (18 deputies). Alfredo Gaspar, the Alagoas candidate, is used as an electoral strategy but does not appear to boost votes.

item.title: Janja repudia fala 'depreciativa' de Renan Santos em debate e aponta 'caráter misógino' do candidato do Missão
item.description: Janja da Silva condemned Renan Santos' remarks during the 2026 presidential debate, labeling them as personal and degrading attacks with misogynistic undertones. Renan suggested Lula would be an alcoholic for living with Janja, interpreted as an attempt to mock the first lady. Janja highlighted a pattern of speeches normalizing disrespect toward women and stressed the importance of condemning such behavior.

item.title: PF: Roberta Luchsinger recebeu R$ 300 mil em espécie e teria pago passagens de Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Roberta Luchsinger for handling R$300,000 in cash and potential payments made on behalf of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. Messages suggest coordination with figures linked to the federal government, including former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro.

item.title: O estado em Flávio amplia vantagem sobre Lula em nove pontos no 2º turno, segundo pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expands lead over Lula in the second round in Rio Grande do Sul, according to Real Time Big Data poll. While Flávio leads with 52% in the second round, Lula reaches only 42%, reflecting high rejection of the president among Rio Grande do Sul voters.

item.title: Eduardo Paes ganharia no 1º turno se eleição fosse hoje, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Paraná Pesquisas released on August 25, 2026 shows Eduardo Paes leading the vote intention for governor of Rio de Janeiro with 44.5%, followed by Douglas Ruas (15.5%) and Anthony Garotinho (11.6%). The survey interviewed 1,600 people between August 22 and 24, with a margin of error of 2.5 percentage points and a 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE under number RJ-02422/2026. Paes has a rejection rate of 25.3%, while Garotinho leads rejections with 40.3%.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente 3ª feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has a scheduled engagement in Brasília on Tuesday (Aug 25, 2026), attending a military ceremony commemorating Soldier's Day at the Army General Staff headquarters at 10 a.m. The agenda is coordinated with the Ministry of Defense and will include military authorities.
